title: Horns of the Berserker
summary: Gain +2 attack rolls against damaged creatures and deal extra melee damage while injured.

fields.Seeking Blood: +2 to attack rolls against already damaged creatures.
fields.Blood Thirst: While below full HP, unarmed and melee attacks deal 2 extra Necrotic. In combat, if you deal no damage on your turn, take 1d4 Necrotic at the end of the turn. The pinned source also reports the bonus on Throw attacks and Fleshmelter Cloak’s Caustic Reprisal.
fields.Acquisition: Buy from Entharl Danthelon in Wyrm’s Crossing.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
